title: HANDOFF_PACKET
description: One seat-to-seat handoff: who is handing over, who is receiving, and what is still unresolved. The receiver rule is the point of this file. A handoff naming a parked receiver — head-of-engineering or developer — or a leftover-only receiver with no live job — head-of-demand, head-of-sales, sdr — is rejected at validation, because handing work to a seat is asking it to run, and neither group runs. Naming a receiver here does not staff, unpark, or hold a seat. This file is self-contained: no external $ref, so it can be checked without a resolver or a network fetch. Writer is the docs leftover; COO is first QC and the PA last-gates. Candidate-visible.

sender.description: The seat handing over. A parked seat cannot be the sender either, because a parked seat ran nothing to hand over.

receiver.description: The seat receiving. Must be one of the 46 slugs, and must be neither parked nor leftover-only with no live job. A handoff to sdr, head-of-sales, head-of-demand, head-of-engineering, or developer fails validation here.

task_packet_ref.description: The packet_id the handed-over work came from.

result_packet_ref.description: The result_packet_id being handed over, when there is one.

unresolved_items.description: What the receiver is inheriting open. An empty array is valid and means nothing is open — it is not a place to quietly drop an open item.

first_qc.description: COO is first QC. The only valid value.

last_gate.description: The PA last-gates. The only valid value.

gate.description: The recorded gate chain, carried on the handoff so it cannot be skipped by moving work sideways.

next_action.description: The one thing the receiver does next. A handoff with no next action is a drop.

why_unresolved.description: Why it is still open. "Not sourced" is a valid reason and is not a failure.

gate_holder.description: The only owners this contract knows. No other holder is recorded, so no other may be named.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date, or date and time. Structural only — it carries no company fact.

no_live_role.description: Leftover-file assigned with no live job to run, so there is no live job to hand them.

role_slug.description: The 46 seat slugs, one per seat page.
